name: fpadd_f32_verilog
testbench_note: tb.sv is byte-identical to benchmarks/fpadd_f32 (the Spire variant): a directed golden-referenced tb, 16.78M vectors, embedded fp_add_e8f23_ref. Both language arms are scored on exactly the same stimuli.

source.design: Verilog arm of fpadd_f32. context/starting_point.v is the SAME starting design as the Spire arm, rendered to Verilog by Spire (FpAdd EW=8 FW=23 subnormals=True), so neither language starts from an advantage.
source.oracle: tb.sv embeds fp_add_e8f23_ref, the benchmark's reference Verilog; subnormals are sampled, not enumerated (2^24 per operand makes exhaustive enumeration unreachable at f32).
